summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for Maritime Connect. 15/15 pytest backend cases pass. Provider chat flow (Chief Engineer / Oil Tanker) end-to-end: role select -> rank/vessel dropdowns -> sea time -> COC multiselect (India, Singapore) -> US visa -> mobile+demo OTP -> consent -> company name/email -> availability -> AI summary review -> submit -> referral link + WhatsApp share -> Dashboard. On Dashboard: Matches tab showed 2 locked cards with 🔒 Locked contacts; Unlock CV Rs20 revealed contact; Documents upload works; Availability/Movement save + timeline works; History renders; Support feedback submitted. Seeker chat flow (Second Officer / Container) end-to-end passed with Skip on optional visa; AI summary generated; referral shown; Boost Profile Rs100 succeeded. Navbar Login dialog with demo OTP 123456 logs user in and shows Logout/Dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses gpt-5.4 model string (non-existent) but has proper try/except fallback to template summary, so AI still returns text. Consider using gpt-5 or gpt-4o. Currently returns template.
seed_data() runs on every startup; storage init failure is only logged, upload endpoint would still attempt init lazily (handled).
matches endpoint returns seeded seekers with user_id='seed' – acceptable for demo; ensure production filters out seed entries.
download_document accepts token via ?auth= query param – acceptable for inline downloads but consider signed URLs in production to avoid token leakage in server logs/referrers.
test_credentials: Any mobile with country code (e.g., +919812345670) + OTP 123456
seed_data_creation: None (backend auto-seeds 6 seekers + 3 providers on startup). Test users named 'TEST Provider Co' and 'TEST Seeker' were created via frontend E2E and left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints in server.py have pytest coverage in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Provider flow uses matches -> unlock-cv (Rs20). Seeker flow uses boost-profile (Rs100). Files uploaded via multipart, downloaded via ?auth=TOKEN query param. Demo OTP is always 123456 and returned as demo_otp in request-otp response. Frontend chat is in /app/frontend/src/components/ChatFlow.jsx with data-testids: role-{seeker|provider}-btn, chat-dropdown, opt-<Value>, quick-<Value>, multi-<Value>, multiselect-confirm, chat-text-input, chat-send-btn, chat-skip-btn, summary-textarea, submit-profile-btn, referral-link, goto-dashboard-btn. Dashboard: tab-{matches|documents|movement|history|support}, unlock-btn-<id>, unlocked-<id>, boost-btn, doc-file-input, movement-save-btn, feedback-submit.
